title: OpenClaw image version
description: Pinned OpenClaw images. Includes both the legacy upstream image (used by current container-stack.ts) and the new extended image with per-env tags (used after the migration completes).

upstream.description: Pinned base OpenClaw image+tag the Dockerfile FROMs — either upstream ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw or the Isol8 fork ghcr.io/thelightbulbcompany/agent.

forkTag.description: Immutable source tag for the Lightbulb OpenClaw fork release.

forkCommit.description: Full immutable Git commit behind forkTag.

baseImageDigest.description: Canonical GHCR digest paired with upstream and the Dockerfile final FROM.

gatewayBuildId.description: Gateway build identifier reported by the pinned fork runtime.

image.description: Legacy: upstream Docker Hub repo name (no tag). Used by current container-stack.ts before the extended-image migration.

tag.description: Legacy: tag for the upstream image. Used by current container-stack.ts.

full.description: Legacy: full upstream reference (image:tag). Used by current container-stack.ts.

extendedImage.description: ECR repository URI for the custom extended image (without tag).

tag.description: Tag of the extended image deployed to dev.

artifactDigest.description: Canonical ECR digest for the promoted extended artifact index.

runtimeManifestDigest.description: Canonical linux/amd64 runtime manifest digest within the promoted artifact.

tag.description: Tag of the extended image deployed to prod.

artifactDigest.description: Canonical ECR digest for the promoted extended artifact index.

runtimeManifestDigest.description: Canonical linux/amd64 runtime manifest digest within the promoted artifact.
